issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
implementation_notes: The AI RMF is explicitly voluntary: 'Like the AI RMF, the Playbook is voluntary and organizations can utilize the suggestions according to their needs and interests.' It does not prescribe risk tolerance and is intended to be flexible and to augment existing risk practices. It provides four core functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE. No penalties or enforcement mechanisms are established.
